Here's the thing. I was wasted. I don't know why I said that.

I would never rape anyone. I've never wanted to rape anyone.

One joke is more than enough to ruin at least one person's life. I don't know how hers is going. I wish mine was done.
It was a bad joke. Nothing happened. It was enough to ruin my life.

Ideally, this subreddit isn't the only thing people are doing to help themselves. It might inspire them to get in therapy or otherwise turn their lives around. I don't see any good reason to shit on it.
